name: Glass video call grid
oneLiner: a video call window on glass: empty slots fill as people join one by one (the brand photo tile, then initials tiles), the participant count ticks, then the speaker tile lifts with a green talking ring and live voice bars while the others settle back
say: when the speaker talks about getting on a call ('I jumped on a call with the team', 'four of us got on a call and I pitched it'): tiles join as they set the scene, the green ring lands on whoever did the talking
